loc.graveyard.name: Misty Graveyard
loc.graveyard.description: Crooked headstones poke out of the fog. Something rattles between the graves. Behind the oldest tomb, worn steps lead down into the dark.

loc.crypt_stairs.name: Crypt Stairs
loc.crypt_stairs.description: Narrow steps slick with damp. The air grows colder with every one, and the fog of the graveyard does not follow you down.

loc.crypt_hall.name: Hall of Names
loc.crypt_hall.description: Names of the hill watch are carved in rows along the walls, most of them worn smooth. Passages open in three directions.

loc.ossuary.name: Ossuary
loc.ossuary.description: Skulls stacked to the ceiling, arranged with terrible care. Something among them is still hungry.

loc.bone_chapel.name: Chapel of Bones
loc.bone_chapel.description: A tiny chapel where the altar is a knight's shield. A pale shape kneels before it, flickering like a candle in a draught.

loc.edric_tomb.name: Edric's Tomb
loc.edric_tomb.description: A stone sarcophagus with its lid pushed aside. Whatever should lie in it now stands guard in front of it.

item.bone.name: Old Bone
item.bone.description: A bone that rattled a moment ago.

item.candle.name: Grave Candle
item.candle.description: A fat black candle. It burns without melting.

item.barrow_shield.name: Barrow Shield
item.barrow_shield.description: A tarnished shield bearing the hill watch's tower. Still solid.

npc.ghoul.name: Crypt Ghoul
npc.ghoul.description: Grey skin stretched over too many teeth.

npc.wight.name: Barrow Wight
npc.wight.description: Armour full of cold light, and nothing else. It wears Edric's colours.

npc.ghost.name: Sir Edric's Shade
npc.ghost.description: The outline of a knight, kneeling, translucent as breath on glass.

start.text: Living one... you should not be below.

options.text: Father Aldric sent me. The tower is lit again.

edric.text: Edric, once captain of the hill watch. I sealed the Hollow King in his tower, and with his last breath he sealed me here, beside my own bones.

seal.text: With a bell, a blade and a promise. The bell is cracked, the blade is buried with me, and the promise... promises wear thin over a hundred years.

sent.text: Then it is time. My wight guards the tomb to the south; it wears my armour and my oath, twisted. Break it. Then climb the hill and end what I could only pause.

advice.text: The harpies on the stairs will try to throw you down. Carry something to heal. And when you face him, do not listen to his voice. Only to your own.
